verdict.rationale: Documented support response times per plan tier is a fair question to ask of a SaaS work-management vendor like monday.com, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions support SLAs, response-time commitments, or how support differs by plan tier. The SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO certifications and the Free plan mention are adjacent topics and do not count.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's documented support response times for each plan tier
